question: Related Questions Q. Waswassa, Talaq 9829 views Q. Please guide me with reference to Shariah, I am in love and physical ralation ship with a lady who is married and not yet divorce, but she is pregnant with my child, her husband was in jail for long time and since then she is trying to get Khula from him but everytime he refuse and the case is going on in Family court in Mumbai, because of her husband contact with goondas no Qazi is ready to get involve in this issue, now my worry is that I cant marry her because she is already married and hence my child becomes illegal which is hurting me and I am always praying to Allah that show mw the right path and help me to get married to her so we can live together rest of our life with no sins in our heart, Please tell me how to get married to her before she deliver the baby. Awaiting for your response. 2359 views Q. My wife calls me beta and mera baccha some times. What is the ruling in shariya for this? What I heard is calling one's husband beta or mera baccha is wrong and one has to pay kaffara for that. The same thing holds good for the husband too, if he calls his wife amma. 12975 views Q. I'm going to divorce my wife,She is a working woman.She wants work during her iddat. 6519 views Q. Right on the custody of my daughter 1535 views Q. I have given two talaqs to my wife in writing almost 13 months back from here. 3901 views Q. What should a man give to his wife when she takes Khula from him becausse of his own fault 19730 views Q. Can you please get clarified my following masla from Mufi sahib. I have been married for 2 years. For the last two months there has been quarrel with my wife on very small issues. Actually, my parents stay in a village and I stay with my wife in a city where I do job. We generally visit my parent 2-3 times in a year for 5-7 days. Recently, when we were at my parent place on a small issue my wife told -"Mujku thumharey maa baap ki zarorat nahi". I got anger and replied -"phir mujku bhi teri zaroorat nahi.". This happens two times. After that I left her at her parents' place. Presently, now and then on phone we start fighting and in anger I used to tell words like -" Hum doono ko nahi ban rah hai", "tho jaa"..etc. I never uttered any word like "talaq". I have following 4 questions- 1. Will the words I told to my wife going to impact my Nikha? 2.Sometimes it comes to my mind to give talaq to my wife, but actually I do not want. And there is always something like wasawasa in my mind that I told talaq in my mind, but I never uttered any word from my mouth even when I was alone. Will this effect my nikha? 3. When somebody spells "talaaq" to wife in her absence, ie no one is around, Is talaq still valid? 4. What should be the minimum sound needed to utter "talaq", so that talaq is valid? 2810 views Q. I had several heated arguments and fights with my wife in the past 2 years or so we have been married. We have 2 kids masha Allah. I dont recall what I said to her most of the times exactly but never told her or even thought about giving talak. Once I did tell her though that she need to call her parents and tell them to come and take her back to their house. I have also many times in these fights to her that if she is not happy with me she has the option to leave me but it will not be done by me to ask her to leave. I would like to understand where we stand and if there is any type of Talak has taken place or not. After most fights within a day or so we are back in good terms. The frequency of these fights have gone down significantly to almost none now alhamdulillah. 2702 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 24229 Country: India Title: I got married as per Sharia Laws on 25th February 2010.. My wife is about 4 months pregnant & we were living very happily together.. Suddenly on 12th June 2010 my wife left her matrimonial house & went to her parents house.. The next day she said she does not want to continue the marriage & she wants a Talaaq.. I dont want to give her Talaaq as i dont have any problem with her & im also worried about the future of my child who has still not come to this world.. Now her parents are saying they will send Khula Notice.. What should i do to save this marriage & also the future of my child. Question: I got married as per Sharia Laws on 25th February 2010.. My wife is about 4 months pregnant & we were living very happily together.. Suddenly on 12th June 2010 my wife left her matrimonial house & went to her parents house.. The next day she said she does not want to continue the marriage & she wants a Talaaq.. I dont want to give her Talaaq as i dont have any problem with her & im also worried about the future of my child who has still not come to this world.. Now her parents are saying they will send Khula Notice.. What should i do to save this marriage & also the future of my child Answer ID: 24229 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1165/1165/M=1431) A woman (wife) should not demand for talaq with no valid reason. It is sin. It is mentioned in hadith that such woman will not get the fragrance of Jannah. Follow the right and appropriate measures whatsoever may be to maintain nikah. If your wife has any reasonable complaint that is in line with Shariah, remove the same and get it solved by mutual understanding. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
